intro: A hidden parchment found aboard the Bloodsail Buccaneer vessels along the Wild Shore presents Cortello's cryptic verse. Deciphering the poem points travelers toward a clue waiting beneath an ornate bridge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is an ornate, well-traveled bridge
East of Deadwind and south of Redridge
Underneath there waits something for you
Some call it a hint, others a clue
There it will lie for endless tomorrows
Biding its time in the Swamp of Sorrows

clips.title: Completion
paras: The soggy parchment contains the next clue....
